title: Tiles from projections of the root and weight lattices of $A_n$
summary: Main purpose of this work is to introduce a general technique of projection of the Voronoi tessellation of the weight lattice $A_n^\ast$ and apply it for the lattice $A_4^\ast$. The projection of the Voronoi tessellation of the weight lattice $A_4^\ast$ produces a totally different tiling scheme than the tiling obtained from the Voronoi cell projection of the lattice $A_4$.
